headline: Zero-shot function vectors survive 2021→2025 and the MHA→GQA shift: mean top-1 accuracy at the peak edit layer rises from GPT-J 65.9% to Llama-2 92.2% / OLMo-2 89.3%, with the mid-layer head-localization signature intact — but the optimal edit layer drifts later in the Qwen (GQA) family, breaking the paper's depth/3 heuristic.

tables.title: Era ladder — zero-shot FV accuracy (this session, bf16; GPT-J/NeoX reused from disk)

figures.caption: Mean top-1 zero-shot FV accuracy at each model's peak edit layer vs release year (3-task subset; GPT-NeoX antonym-only). Color = family, marker = MHA (circle) / GQA (square); faint line = no-FV baseline; stems show the base→+FV gap. FV survives and generally strengthens 2021→2025.
figures.alt: Scatter of FV accuracy 57-92% across 2021-2025 far above a near-zero baseline, colored by family.

figures.caption: Peak FV edit layer as a fraction of model depth vs year. Llama-2/OLMo-2 stay in the paper's early-mid band (~0.26–0.37); the Qwen GQA family drifts later (0.55–0.64), so editing at depth/3 no longer works for Qwen.
figures.alt: Peak-layer fraction near 0.3 for most models but 0.55-0.64 for the two Qwen GQA models.

figures.caption: Left: top-AIE heads remain concentrated in the first ⅔ of layers (C5) across families. Right: prefix-matching (induction) score of top-K AIE heads vs all heads (C13) — enriched for GPT-J/Llama-2/Qwen but not OLMo-2.
figures.alt: Bar charts of mid-layer head concentration and induction-head overlap per model.

notes: bf16 (native precision) used for all new models instead of the instruction's fp32, for the 8 GPU-h budget; rank-based accuracies are unaffected. GPT-J/NeoX reused fp16 from disk.

3-task subset {antonym, country-capital, present-past} (cost cap fallback) for all new models; GPT-J anchor recomputed on the same subset. Full-6-task GPT-J anchor: paper 57.5% / replicated 55.0% @L9.
SL FV measured at peak layer only; C16 #heads plateau for antonym per model (plateau k: Llama-2 11, OLMo-2 8, matching paper ~10; Qwen2.5 25, Qwen3 27 — GQA needs more heads).
Two model-specific failures: Qwen3 country-capital FV fails entirely (5.1% = baseline); OLMo-2 top-AIE heads are NOT induction-enriched.

Qwen3-8B needed transformers 4.53 in an isolated overlay venv (pinned 4.49 lacks the qwen3 arch); the pinned run venv was untouched. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (rung 6) skipped: gated, not local. Single seed (42).
Shape guard (o_proj.in == n_heads·head_dim) passed for all 4 run models; no model was skipped for invalid head decomposition.
